Antonino Cilione Data Engineer | Software Engineer Reggio Calabria, Italy | +39 347 252 7757 | antoninocilione96@gmail.com github.com/acilione | acilione.github.io linkedin.com/in/antonino-cilione-1258291a6 Summary Data engineer with 4+ years of experience building distributed data platforms for the energy
sector. Develops data pipelines, optimizes Spark workloads, and builds Java/Kotlin backend
services. Combines production data engineering with full-stack projects using Python, SQL,

Apache Spark and Kafka, supporting downstream energy-grid analysis. Led a migration from Cloudera Distribution Hadoop (CDH) to Cloudera Data Platform
(CDP), modernizing the distributed data infrastructure. Develop and tune Spark ETL workloads and Apache NiFi ingestion flows; benchmark
Apache Iceberg with Spark and Flink. Implemented custom equality-delete file commits in Spark workloads using Apache
Iceberg. Optimize MongoDB Atlas indexes, memory usage, and autoscaling; integrate Redis
caching through Redisson in Spark jobs. Build Java/Kotlin microservices with Spring Boot to expose MongoDB data through APIs. Automate S3 Parquet merge, deduplication, backup, and restore operations with Python,
and Kafka/S3 checks with Bash. Built a Go desktop tool with Fyne to automate Excel processing, data filtering, and report
generation. Android Developer - Iriscube Reply Feb 2022 - Jul 2022 Developed features and fixed defects in a corporate Android banking application. Migrated application code from Java to Kotlin and maintained existing functionality.
